findings.summary: This modeling limitation is kept, as the prompt directed. The installed law/schemas/adr.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false, and when status is active it requires supersedes to have minItems:1. So no partial-scope field can be added, and the binding cannot be removed. The Status section limits supersession to activation timing. Both index rows use the existing partial 'Vigência' convention, and ADR-0055/0056 remain Accepted with unchanged bytes. The only repo consumer of supersedes seen is the state-index check, which still passes. That check's PC supersedes logic covers rounds, not ADR retirement.
findings.failure_scenario: A future tool that reads the ADR frontmatter alone could treat ADR-0055/0056 as fully superseded. No current consumer does this.
